steps.title: Create OAuth2 app in Help Scout
steps.detail: Go to Your Profile > My apps and click Create My App. Enter a redirection URL; for Client Credentials only, a placeholder URL works.

traps.title: Client Credentials tokens expire after 2 days
traps.detail: Expiry shows as HTTP 401; create a new token only then. Authorization Code tokens are renewed with a refresh token.

traps.title: Redirection URL is required for Authorization Code
traps.detail: Set it correctly when creating the app; users return to it after authorizing.

blockers.what_it_means: The token expired, or the credential's user is not active and invited in the account.
